title: Privacy Policy
intro: At Peerless Brokerage Inc, we value your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services ("Services").

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We may collect personal information, including but not limited to, your name, email address, phone number, and other relevant details to provide you with our Services.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to:
bullets: Communicate with you regarding customer care and support
Respond to inquiries and fulfill requests

sections.heading: Sharing of Information
sections.body:
We do NOT sell or share your personal information to third parties for marketing or promotional purposes. Your information will remain confidential, and we will only share it if required by law or necessary to fulfill the Services provided.

Mobile information will not be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes. All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

sections.heading: Communication Opt-Out
sections.body: If you wish to be removed from receiving future communications, you can opt out by texting STOP, QUIT, END, REVOKE, OPT OUT, CANCEL, or UNSUBSCRIBE.
